title: Array copy leaves a prefix before an incompatible element
summary: Prevalidating all elements preserves exception classes but loses the writes preceding an incompatible boxed integer.

change.description: Prevalidating all elements preserves exception classes but loses the writes preceding an incompatible boxed integer.

notes: The JVM copied 40 typed Object[] sources into fresh String[] destinations. Both implementations threw ArrayStoreException on 25 inputs. Twelve destinations differed. For the source containing A and boxed 1, the reference left [A, x] and the precheck left [x, x].
The complete table freezes the runtime component types, nulls, source values, exception class and final destination. The selected adapter fields are checked independently against direct calls.
